landing.heroTitle: Certified laptops ready to keep building.
landing.heroBody: Devices selected with technical judgment, reviewed for real use and prepared for a second useful life.
landing.meaningBody: Certified Tech is a curated selection of laptops reviewed for condition, performance and value. It is not about selling any used device: it is about choosing technology that can still perform clearly.
landing.processCards: Selection by real value|We prioritize devices with good performance, reliable construction and meaning for students, creators and professionals.;Technical review|Hardware, physical condition, storage, battery when applicable and general use conditions are reviewed.;Initial preparation|Cleaning, recommendations and base setup when the device requires it.
landing.purposeBody: Choosing a certified device helps use functional technology and reduce unnecessary replacements. It is practical, economical and more responsible with electronic waste.
landing.receiveItems: Selected and reviewed device|Care guidance|Access to post-purchase registration|WhatsApp support|Referral benefit participation
landing.referralBody: When someone buys through your recommendation, you can take part in preventive maintenance, upgrade discounts or selected accessories.
landing.finalTitle: Certified technology. Smart purchase. Less waste.
landing.finalBody: Message us to learn about available devices or register your purchase if you already have your certified laptop.
